summary: Elbit Systems filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release dated November 2, 2026, announcing an approximately $170 million contract award from the Israel Ministry of Defense (IMOD) to establish and operate an advanced training and simulation center for the IDF Artillery Corps. Performance spans 15 years, supporting integration of the ROEM (SIGMA) self-propelled artillery and LAHAV (PULS) precision rocket launcher systems, including simulators, classrooms, AI-based simulation and long-term training and maintenance services. No board recommendation, advisor, ownership, financing or regulatory mechanics are involved; this is an ordinary contract award, not a special situation, so no deal-risk arbitrage angle applies.
